verdict.rationale: The OpenAI Agents SDK is itself a programmatic library, and its first-party docs describe a public API for driving it. That API includes the Runner class with run, run_sync and run_streamed, agents configured with tools, handoffs and guardrails, sessions, and resumable RunState. Community users report hands-on use of this API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404), plus evidence of a full API reference covering every method and parameter beyond the guide-level docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can run agents via the Runner class. You have 3 options: Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), Runner.run_streamed()
Runner.run_streamed(), which runs async and returns a RunResultStreaming
When a tool call requires approval, the SDK pauses the run, returns interruptions, and lets you resume later from the same RunState.
Build text, sandbox, and voice agents with a small set of primitives.
